# Number input: `jl-number-input`

A number field with − and + buttons, arrow keys and bounds.

- Class `JlNumberInput`, a molecule: `import { JlNumberInput } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/number-input

A number field with − and + buttons: a quantity, a count of seats, a percentage. The arrow keys step
it, Page Up and Page Down by ten steps, Home and End go to min and max when they are set.

People can also type: the text is read when they leave the field or press Enter (which then submits the form it is
in, as from a native field), kept between min and max, and put back as it was when it is not a number. An empty field is null; with required, the form cannot be submitted
while it is empty. Decimal steps (0.1, 0.25) add up without float noise.

## Use

```ts
import { JlNumberInput } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlNumberInput label="Quantity" max={10} min={0} value={1} />
```

```html
<jl-number-input label="Quantity" max="10" min="0" value="1"></jl-number-input>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `value` (attribute `value`): `number | null`, default `null`. The number; null while the field is empty.
- `min` (attribute `min`): `number | null`, default `null`. The lowest value; none when null.
- `max` (attribute `max`): `number | null`, default `null`. The highest value; none when null.
- `step` (attribute `step`): `number`, default `1`. What a button or an arrow key adds or takes away.
- `placeholder` (attribute `placeholder`): `string`, default `''`. Shown while empty.
- `size` (attribute `size`): `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`, default `'md'`. The height.
- `name` (attribute `name`): `string`, default `''`. The field's name in the form's data.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The accessible name, when no visible label names the field.
- `required` (attribute `required`): `boolean`, default `false`. The form cannot be submitted while it is empty.
- `disabled` (attribute `disabled`): `boolean`, default `false`. Cannot be changed or focused.
- `invalid` (attribute `invalid`): `boolean`, default `false`. Drawn in the danger colour, for an error the page found.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `change` (`onChange` in JSX), detail `number | null`: The value changed: a step, a button, or text committed on Enter or when leaving the field.

## Methods

- `stepBy(count: number): void`: Adds count steps (negative to go down), within the bounds, and fires change.
- `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`: Focuses the field.
- `checkValidity(): boolean`: Whether a required field has a number.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The frame around the field and its buttons.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Bounds

The buttons are disabled at the bounds.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-number-input label="Quantity" value="1" min="1" max="10" style="width: 140px"></jl-number-input>
  <jl-number-input label="Guests" value="10" min="1" max="10" style="width: 140px"></jl-number-input>
</div>
```

### Decimal steps

```html
  <jl-number-input label="Rating" value="4.5" min="0" max="5" step="0.5" style="width: 140px"></jl-number-input>
  <jl-number-input label="Ratio" value="0.2" step="0.1" style="width: 140px"></jl-number-input>
</div>
```

```html

  <jl-number-input label="Disabled" value="12" disabled></jl-number-input>
  <jl-number-input label="Invalid" value="0" invalid></jl-number-input>
```

### Listening

The total listens to change.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-number-input class="demo-seats" label="Seats" value="3" min="1" max="50" style="width: 140px"></jl-number-input>
  <span class="muted demo-total">3 seats × 12 CHF = 36 CHF / month</span>
</div>
```

```js
const seats = root.querySelector('.demo-seats');
const total = root.querySelector('.demo-total');
seats.events.register('change', (count) => {
  const value = count ?? 0;
  total.textContent = `${value} seats × 12 CHF = ${value * 12} CHF / month`;
});
```
